en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from one of his companion, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding

four who testified upon a married man with the adultery. Then one of them retracted after the man had been killed. Heasws said : ‘If the fourth one says, ‘I was delusional’, he would be struck the legal penalty (Hadd), and fined the wergild. And if he says, ‘I was deliberate’, he would be killed’.
